words.definition: a product or device that improves the condition of something, such as hair or air
words.example: The air conditioner in the meeting room needs repair.
words.exampleTranslation: 會議室的冷氣機需要維修。
words.note: 常見於 air conditioner（冷氣機）這個複合詞

words.definition: to officially register for a course or program
words.example: New employees must enroll in the benefits program within 30 days.
words.exampleTranslation: 新進員工必須在三十天內報名福利方案。
words.note: 常用片語 enroll in（報名參加），例如 enroll in a training program。

words.definition: to cause someone to feel annoyed or discouraged
words.example: The repeated delays frustrated the entire project team.
words.exampleTranslation: 一再的延誤讓整個專案團隊都感到挫折。
words.note: 相關詞：frustrated (adj.) 感到挫折的、frustrating (adj.) 令人沮喪的，例如 a frustrating delay。

words.definition: an item of clothing
words.example: Each garment is inspected before it leaves the factory.
words.exampleTranslation: 每件衣物離開工廠前都會經過檢查。
words.note: 服飾業常用 garment 這個正式用語，日常口語較常說 clothes

words.definition: an introductory session to help someone become familiar with a new place or job
words.example: All new hires attend an orientation on their first day.
words.exampleTranslation: 所有新進人員在到職第一天都要參加新人訓練。
words.note: 常見於 orientation session（新人訓練說明會）這個搭配詞

words.definition: a store that sells goods directly, or a socket for electrical devices
words.example: The factory outlet sells last season's stock at a discount.
words.exampleTranslation: 工廠暢貨中心以折扣價出售上一季的庫存。
words.note: 常見於 retail outlet（暢貨中心）與 electrical outlet（電源插座）等搭配詞

words.definition: a small package or a set of papers bundled together
words.example: Each attendee received an information packet at registration.
words.exampleTranslation: 每位與會者在報到時都收到一份資料袋。
words.note: 常見於 information packet（資料袋）這個搭配詞

words.definition: a person who installs and repairs water pipes and fixtures
words.example: A plumber was called to fix the leak in the restroom.
words.exampleTranslation: 有人請了水管工來修理洗手間的漏水。
words.note: 發音注意：字中的 b 不發音，讀作 /ˈplʌmər/

words.definition: a detailed description of requirements or standards
words.example: The parts must meet the client's exact specifications.
words.exampleTranslation: 這些零件必須符合客戶精確的規格要求。
words.note: 口語中常簡稱為 specs，例如 meet the specs

words.definition: short for automobile; a car
words.example: The company provides an auto allowance for sales staff.
words.exampleTranslation: 公司提供給業務人員汽車補助。
words.note: 常見於 auto insurance（汽車保險）、auto industry（汽車產業）等複合詞

words.definition: to make something look more attractive by adding items
words.example: The team decorated the office for the holiday party.
words.exampleTranslation: 團隊為了節慶派對佈置了辦公室。
words.note: 相關詞：decoration (n.) 裝飾品；裝飾，例如 holiday decorations。

words.definition: an amount subtracted from a total, especially from pay or tax
words.example: Tax deductions are listed on the back of your pay stub.
words.exampleTranslation: 薪資單背面列出了稅務扣除額。
words.note: 動詞形：deduct (v.) 扣除，例如 The company will deduct tax from your salary。

words.definition: clearly certain and not likely to change
words.example: We need a definite answer from the supplier by Friday.
words.exampleTranslation: 我們需要供應商在週五前給出明確的答覆。
words.note: 反義詞：definite（明確的）前面加上否定字首 in- 就變成 indefinite

words.definition: giving good value for the money spent
words.example: Buying supplies in bulk is more economical.
words.exampleTranslation: 大量採購用品比較經濟實惠。
words.note: 易混淆詞：economical（節省的）與 economic（經濟的）意思不同，例如 economic policy（經濟政策）

words.definition: in a way that achieves results without wasting time or resources
words.example: The new software helps the team process orders more efficiently.
words.exampleTranslation: 新軟體幫助團隊更有效率地處理訂單。
words.note: 相關詞：efficiency (n.) 效率，例如 improve efficiency。

words.definition: a printed sheet advertising an event or product
words.example: Flyers for the grand opening were distributed downtown.
words.exampleTranslation: 開幕活動的傳單在市中心被發放。
words.note: 拼字注意：也可拼作 flier，意思相同

words.definition: authorization to sell a company's goods or services in a particular area
words.example: She purchased a franchise for the coffee shop chain.
words.exampleTranslation: 她買下了那間連鎖咖啡店的加盟權。
words.note: 常見於 fast-food franchise（連鎖速食加盟店）這個搭配詞

words.definition: willing to give more than what is expected, especially money or time
words.example: The company offers a generous vacation policy.
words.exampleTranslation: 這家公司提供很優渥的休假政策。
words.note: 相關詞：generosity (n.) 慷慨，例如 thank you for your generosity。

words.definition: to stop something from continuing by breaking in
words.example: Sorry to interrupt, but the client is on the phone.
words.exampleTranslation: 抱歉打斷一下，客戶來電話了。
words.note: 相關詞：interruption (n.) 打斷；中斷，例如 sorry for the interruption。

words.definition: an enclosed appliance used for cooking or baking food
words.example: The break room's oven is available for staff use.
words.exampleTranslation: 茶水間的烤箱開放給員工使用。
words.note: 常見於 oven mitt（隔熱手套）這個複合詞
